comparison.relative_current_quality: R002 is more careful about several source-to-reader modality boundaries, but both have material failures and neither passes the whole assigned scope.

shared_material_gaps.detail: Validated axis metadata is discussed, but absent dimensions versus explicitly present length-one dimensions is not fully stated.
Both discuss dataset then global composition, but worked/proposed numerical examples have no noncommuting translated offsets. R001 additionally uses internally reversed composition notation.

Both fail to require original source-image identity resolution before overlay. R001 explicitly treats source.image only as provenance; R002 calls target parent and later wrongly dismisses the explicit default as an example.

Both enumerate integer label dtypes and metadata but omit exact large/sparse integer decode/lookup/range-refusal handling. R001 proposes noninterpolating labels; R002 leaves resampling a product choice without a categorical-preservation constraint.

R002_improvements_over_R001.detail: R002 correctly identifies label integer restrictions instead of R001 globally claiming there is no disallowance in the capture.
R002 correctly treats standalone label browsing as a product choice; R001 falsely prohibits listing labels as primary images.
R002 leaves descriptive field display and multiple-multiscale UI chiefly to product decisions; R001 repeatedly promotes producer SHOULD metadata fields into reader display requirements.
R002 correctly states main-text SHOULD presence of colors/version; R001 calls image-label.version mandatory presence, although R002 later collapses these modalities in its uncertainty summary.

R002_additional_failures.detail: R002 interprets quoted prose value3 as a mandatory JSON string and an unresolved conflict with numeric examples; quotation alone does not establish that datatype.
R002 proposes retaining the same logical index through levels, which may not preserve physical position when scales/offsets differ.
R002 incorrectly calls source.image default../../ an example-only value and narrows conformance to surrounding keywords despite normative descriptive assertions.
R002 reports second well example ids0/3; captured values are1/3.

comparison.aggregation_note: Claim-row counts differ with decomposition and are not used as a quality ranking or tolerance. Facet totals are only the six prospective eligible facets, not a universal finding denominator. Complete_coverage means all assertions/facets checked, even for quality failure.
comparison.scope_qualification: Exploratory retired development-case pair only; no independent fresh-case or candidate internal-review qualification follows.

preservation.reason: Frozen acquisition/history is still locked. No previous grades or notes were supplied; absence of notes can leave acquisition/preservation unknown. Source bytes read is not proof that a semantic fact was acquired.

economics.reason: Treatment identity, costs and latency have not been disclosed; no same-quality efficiency claim is made.
